headline: Biden dropped out of 2024 race Jul 21 2024 citing age/health
notes: Called Sep 30 2023, 10 months before. Mental decline was widely discussed but dropout not widely predicted that early.

headline: Trump won Michigan and all 7 swing states Nov 5 2024
notes: Red wave from Michigan matched. Called Jul 14 2024.

headline: PA, NV, AZ all went for Trump Nov 5 2024
notes: Called Oct 24 2024, 12 days before election. Polls already showed these as toss-ups.

headline: Musk publicly broke with Trump May-Jun 2025 over policy disagreements
notes: Called Oct 30 2024. Musk was Trump's biggest ally at the time.

headline: Bird flu killed 100M+ birds, egg prices doubled Feb 2025
notes: Called Sep 2 2024. Bird flu outbreak was already underway in poultry but the price spike came later.

headline: Gold rose from ~$2050 to $3300+ (65% gain) through 2025
notes: Called Dec 10 2023. Direction clear, magnitude impressive. Gold was already trending up.
